blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Face-to-face classes in all levels in public and private schools in Cebu City will be suspended on Monday, October 12, following a rise in the city’s Air Quality Index (AQI) to 180, classified as “very unhealthy.” Mayor Nestor Archival announced the suspension in a public advisory on Sunday evening, October 11. He directed schools to shift to asynchronous classes as a precaution to protect students, teachers, and school personnel from unhealthy air quality. The advisory, issued at 6:30 p.m., covers all levels of public and private schools in the city and takes effect on Monday, October 12. […]...
